metadata.calibration_status: Synthetic demonstration assumptions; not field calibrated

provenance.geometry: Organizer-provided challenge geometry; mapped adjacency is not electrical topology
provenance.baseline: Frozen fit to 3,600 independent healthy synthetic records per seed
provenance.inference: Hand-specified current-window Bayesian network; exact enumeration
provenance.dispatch: Nearby stationary imagery reuse, then greedy priority with travel, recharge and origin-coverage constraints
provenance.route: Point-to-point simulated leg; no obstacle, terrain or airspace validation
provenance.nearby_imagery: Assumed RGB access within 25 metres and a shared mapped endpoint; no line-of-sight validation, shared telemetry or inferred electrical connection

assumptions.inference_mode: current_window; no recursive multiplication of adjacent windows

chapters.title: Conditions & coverage
chapters.headline:
Limited coverage.
A changing environment.
chapters.what: The gust warning has ended. Five drones cover only part of the mapped network.
chapters.summary: The gust warning has ended. Five drones cover only part of the mapped network.
chapters.why: An unobserved line is Unknown, not healthy. Limited drones must choose where to collect evidence.
chapters.next: Watch received reports and retain coverage at sites with unresolved anomalies.

chapters.title: A new observer report
chapters.headline:
A report is a reason
to investigate.
chapters.what: An observer reports recurring movement near LINE_058, where there is no live measurement.
chapters.summary: An observer reports recurring movement near LINE_058, where there is no live measurement.
chapters.why: This is an unverified high-priority lead. It creates a need for evidence, not a confirmed fault.
chapters.next: Check whether a nearby stationary drone can obtain the requested view.

chapters.title: Reuse nearby coverage
chapters.headline:
A nearby view.
No extra flight.
chapters.what: Drone 4 starts a nearby RGB inspection from LINE_025, about 7.3 metres from LINE_058.
chapters.summary: Drone 4 starts a nearby RGB inspection from LINE_025, about 7.3 metres from LINE_058.
chapters.why: The lines share a mapped endpoint and are within the assumed 25-metre viewing radius. Drone 4 can take images while charging; Drone 5 stays available.
chapters.next: Collect the target's image without moving Drone 4 or transferring LINE_025 telemetry.

chapters.title: Inspect without another flight
chapters.headline:
Collect the image.
Keep charging.
chapters.what: Drone 4 takes a four-minute stationary RGB view of the adjacent line while its recharge continues.
chapters.summary: Drone 4 takes a four-minute stationary RGB view of the adjacent line while its recharge continues.
chapters.why: Nearby imagery is an explicit simulation capability. It provides no contact measurements of the target and assumes a usable view.
chapters.next: Receive the image at T+51, then review what the evidence can establish.

chapters.title: Separate imagery from telemetry
chapters.headline:
An image arrives.
The coverage gap remains.
chapters.what: The image result is recorded for LINE_058 with Drone 4's actual observation location.
chapters.summary: The image result is recorded for LINE_058 with Drone 4's actual observation location.
chapters.why: LINE_058 still has no asset-specific telemetry. The model keeps its assessment Unknown and does not calculate a sensor posterior from LINE_025's readings.
chapters.next: Keep the coverage-review request open; release the separate LINE_015 lead after this image result.

chapters.title: Use the available drone for a distant lead
chapters.headline:
Save the flight
for a distant lead.
chapters.what: The LINE_058 image result releases the received LINE_015 follow-up. Drone 5 can serve this distant location.
chapters.summary: The LINE_058 image result releases the received LINE_015 follow-up. Drone 5 can serve this distant location.
chapters.why: Drone 4 continues charging at LINE_025. LINE_015 lies beyond its nearby viewing radius, so this request needs a real simulated flight.
chapters.next: Dispatch Drone 5 from LINE_009 at T+52, subject to weather, recharge and origin-coverage constraints.

chapters.title: Fly to the distant inspection
chapters.headline:
From an available drone
to an on-site inspection.
chapters.what: Drone 5 follows its recorded flight from LINE_009 to LINE_015; arrival is T+78.
chapters.summary: Drone 5 follows its recorded flight from LINE_009 to LINE_015; arrival is T+78.
chapters.why: The 26-minute leg is time compressed here. In-flight motion supplies no usable target telemetry, and LINE_015 stays Unknown until arrival.
chapters.next: Land, keep the mandatory recharge running and collect four minutes of stationary evidence.

chapters.title: Observe the target after arrival
chapters.headline:
Now on site.
Now target telemetry.
chapters.what: At T+78 Drone 5 arrives at LINE_015. Its stationary telemetry can now be compared with the current weather-conditioned healthy baseline.
chapters.summary: At T+78 Drone 5 arrives at LINE_015. Its stationary telemetry can now be compared with the current weather-conditioned healthy baseline.
chapters.why: The Bayesian model combines the current mechanical, thermal and sensor explanations. It recomputes each window and excludes transit readings.
chapters.next: Finish the RGB inspection at T+82 and compare the same telemetry window with and without the received image.

chapters.title: Update the same-window decision
chapters.headline:
One telemetry window.
One received image.
chapters.what: At T+82 the clear RGB view updates LINE_015's current telemetry window. The recommendation remains Continue monitoring.
chapters.summary: At T+82 the clear RGB view updates LINE_015's current telemetry window. The recommendation remains Continue monitoring.
chapters.why: The synthetic anomaly estimate changes from a 4.94% window prior to 0.100% after sensors and 0.058% after the image. A clear RGB view remains imperfect evidence.
chapters.next: Continue monitoring LINE_015 while the separate LINE_058 telemetry gap and its human coverage-review request remain unresolved.

The evaluator reads fault labels after inference and action recommendations to score the resulting predictions.
Each run scores the current assessment at one evaluation timestamp.
Expected loss values use hypothetical relative cost units.
Results describe model responses to the configured synthetic fault and observation generators.
Matched synthetic samples provide descriptive comparisons across scenarios and seeds.
metadata.scope: Six synthetic scenarios, matched seeds 42–47, five stationed slots per run at T+55. No dynamic mission or field-performance claim.
